top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete and mature mechanistic chain: proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) amide, its glucose-dependent insulinotropic and appetite actions in humans, and receptor biology, with independent randomized outcome trials confirming the clinical consequence. The allocation to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov keeps all three places on one coherent physiology discovery. Mojsov's priority relative to the Habener group and the exclusion of Knudsen are residual attribution risks, but they do not outweigh awarding a prize of this scale and maturity over no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I have co-authored with committee member Sten Linnarsson and with Jonas Frisen, but no credited name in P001 is involved, and shared Karolinska Institutet affiliation is not a tie to any candidate
